scenario: Single-line string literals may not contain physical newlines per LGRA.2.9.2 — the lexer rejects this before the parser even sees it. Pin: DS_LEX_GENERIC is emitted when a newline is embedded in a double-quoted single-line string.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    log info "line one
line two"
